feeds.title: The Stata Blog
feeds.description: StataCorp develops, distributes, and supports Stata statistical software. Stata is a general-purpose system intended for use by research professionals. On The Stata Blog, we will try to keep you up-to-date about all things related to the Stata Statistical Software.

feeds.title: EViews Blog
feeds.description: Discover EViews's econometric analysis insight blog posts. EViews, a part of S&P Global, the popular MicroTSP software, offers academic researchers, corporations, government agencies, and students access to powerful statistical forecasting and modeling tools through an easy-to-use object-oriented interface.

feeds.title: Eran Raviv Blog » Statistics and Econometrics
feeds.description: check my blogs on the topic of Modern statistics and econometrics with applications to financial markets. I am Eran Raviv, working for a large pension fund manager and the author of this blog. Here, you can read about topics I think I want to know more about, or topics I feel there is something to be said about, not easily found elsewhere.

feeds.title: econometrics.blog
feeds.description: This is a blog about econometrics, statistics, and related topics. I am Francis J. DiTraglia, an associate professor of Economics and a researcher. On this website, I will provide the information and insights related to my ongoing research model selection and averaging measurement error and models with social interactions.

feeds.title: Aptech Blog » Econometrics
feeds.description: Aptech Blog provides a straightforward understanding of Econometrics. Aptech Systems, a supportive team of experts. Aptech helps people achieve their goals by offering products and applications that define the leading edge of statistical analysis capabilities.

feeds.title: Scott's Mixtape Substack
feeds.description: Scott's Mixtape Substack by Scott Cunningham is dedicated to educating people about causal inference. Simplifying complex topics in causal inference and econometrics, it offers high-quality content, and other resources.

feeds.title: Cambridge Econometrics Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest economic news from Cambridge Econometrics Blog. Cambridge Econometrics is an economic consultancy, specializes in the application of economic modeling and data analysis techniques. Our mission is to provide clarity on the complexities facing the economy, society, and the environment.

feeds.title: QuantInsti Blog » Mathematics and Econometrics
feeds.description: Learn the practical applications of mathematics and econometrics in finance. QuantInsti Blog covers time series analysis, portfolio management, probability distribution, econometrics, and many mathematical models.

feeds.title: How the (Econometric) Sausage is Made
feeds.description: I am the Robert H. and Nancy Dedman Trustee Professor of Economics as well as a researcher and author of this blog. My research is based on micro-econometric methods and applications in labor economics, environmental economics, health economics, and international trade. Here you will learn all about econometrics.

feeds.title: Econometric Sense
feeds.description: Matt Bogard is the author of this website. He is an analytical translator and problem solver. He brings together his knowledge of applied and behavioral economics and life sciences to influence internal stakeholders and external thought leaders.

feeds.title: Online Econometrics Tutor Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Nimit, and I started this website. I provide online training, project support, assignment, and examination help to students. I will make you learn econometrics through statistical software including; STATA, EVIEWS, R, and more.

feeds.title: Bruno Rodrigues
feeds.description: My name is Bruno Rodrigues and hold a Ph.D. in Economics. I started this blog to share my enthusiasm for statistics. I also enjoy learning about the R programming language and sharing my knowledge with tips and tricks.

feeds.title: MetaMetrics » Econometrics
feeds.description: At MetaMetrics, we are an independent analytical consultancy specializing in marketing econometric modeling. We are a team of highly experienced, expert econometricians. We're passionate about helping our clients make better marketing decisions.
